user.title: Set up Smart Heating
user.description: Only a name and time zone are needed to start. Smart Heating remains passive; review mappings and backend sections afterwards.

confirm.title: Confirm associations
confirm.description: Suggestions: {selected}. Ambiguous: {ambiguous}. Missing: {missing}. Nothing is stored without confirmation; Smart Heating remains passive.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Configure the weekly schedule. Overlaps are rejected.

error.confirmation_required: Review the suggestions and explicitly confirm them.
error.active_control_unavailable: Active control is not available yet. Smart Heating remains in observe-only mode.

abort.already_configured: Smart Heating is already configured. Open the existing entry under Settings → Devices & services.

settings.title: Smart Heating settings
settings.description: Operating mode, summer strategy, and safety values. In observe-only mode Smart Heating calculates demand and recommendations without changing thermostats, automations, or other devices. Active control is not available yet. Edit the weekly schedule, window contacts, and room assignments in the Smart Heating sidebar; existing mappings are preserved.

data_description.summer_mode: Smart Heating evaluates summer operation. Observe-only mode never switches thermostats off.
data_description.operation_mode: Observe only calculates demand and recommendations. Active heating control is not available yet.
data_description.chimney_temperature: Target used for chimney-sweep calculation. Observe-only mode never transfers a temperature to the heater.
data_description.frost_temperature: Threshold for passive frost-protection evaluation. Observe-only mode never changes thermostats.

options.hvac_off: Switch heating off in summer (not available yet)
